# clerk_svix_webhook (Resource)

Manages the Svix webhook integration for a Clerk instance. This is a singleton resource — only one can exist per instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "clerk_svix_webhook" "main" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier for this singleton resource.
- `svix_url` (String) The Svix dashboard URL for managing webhooks.
